text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Guess it's about time to get going.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
A hot spring.
...I figured the time was right.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Let us take this chance to wash away the fatigue of a journey that reached its ultimate limit.

And so, we decided to use
the hot spring ticket we had saved—
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Phew.
The food is great, this is a nice inn...
choice_data_list: The hot springs were nice too...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: "...There are few clouds tonight, so the stars should be clearly visible."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: How about it? Care to take a short walk after this?
choice_data_list: Sounds good, let's go get some night air.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ......It's a nice night.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's ride the waves a bit.

Stay Gold's performance blended pleasantly
with the night air. It felt just like
resting in a cradle of sound.
When we first met, Stay Gold was playing the harmonica too.

Her and the notes of her harmonica have become
completely inseparable from my own journey up to this day――

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Sound carries well tonight.
choice_data_list: ...Since when have you liked the harmonica?
...Since when did you like the harmonica?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Since when, huh...
...I wonder since when—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, when I first heard
that melody as a child...
I felt strangely nostalgic.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
So you got interested, and...
that brings us to where we are now, huh?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: "Harmonicas are great. Easy to carry around on travels, too."

A realization strikes me.
Once Stay Gold leaves on her next long journey,
I won't be able to hear her melodies like this anymore.
choice_data_list: ...It's a shame I won't get to hear it for a while.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...What do you know.
You really liked my playing that much?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha! Aren't you honest.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: "...Well, hearing you say that makes me genuinely happy, too."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Make sure you engrave this melody into your memory.
And so, a little time passed—

...The day for Stay Gold to embark on her long journey
had finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I'm heading out.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: …………Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Here.

Saying so, Stay Gold
handed me a small paper bag.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Open it after I've gone.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: If fate allows, let's meet again.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —See ya, Trainer.
...And so Stay Gold, as nonchalant as ever, set off on a long journey――
...After being left alone, I opened the paper bag Stay Gold gave me. Inside, there was—

I find a playback device,
insert the cassette tape I received,
and press the play button.
...After a brief silence—
...There was no mistaking it.

That beautiful melody
I heard so many times along my journey—
choice_data_list: Even though I told you to remember...

text_block_list.text:
"...When I close my eyes, it comes back to me.
Along with that melody, her figure appears—"

—The playback stops.
...And silence falls.
Rewind, and press the play button once more.
It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable bond with Stay Gold...
